trackerLog.subject: Framefield
trackerLog.note: Tracker is published. It is the live board. Framefield implementation does not keep a local tracker file. Impl reads the published Tracker site. Impl reports status as XML snippets in the Framefield chat. This Tracker chat is the only writer to Tracker-Log (HEAD.xml, dated xml, MANIFEST.txt). Design still does not edit Framefield source.
trackerLog.decision: After publish: Tracker is read-only for impl. Writes only happen in the Tracker workspace log folder. Framefield_Tracker.json and the old HTML tracker stay retired. Status, bugs, and set exits are logged here, then the user pastes a short brief into the Framefield chat.
